name: Static in the Snow
description: Requested by: Research Division. A research team studying the snowfield has gone silent. Their last transmission was garbled with static. Locate the expedition camp and ensure the team's safety.

objects.text: Expedition Log, Day 3: Creature activity higher than the survey predicted. Monitoring equipment placed along the ridge line.
Expedition Log, Day 5: Lost two cases of supplies to a reyhound pack. Reconsidering the outpost location.
Expedition Log, Day 7: Retreating to the old survey caves. The wildlife avoids them. Marking the entrance for our return trip.
Expedition Log, Day 9: Setting traps at the choke points. If anyone reads this, follow the markings deeper. We've left supplies along the way.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: Over here! Quickly, before they circle back!

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: Thank you. I wasn't sure anyone would find us out here.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: I'm Dr. Carlo. When we're back in town, drinks are on me. Let's move.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Principal
briefing_dialog.text: We've lost contact with a research team in the snowfield. Their last transmission was mostly static.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Principal
briefing_dialog.text: They were conducting survey work in the deep snow region. We don't know what happened.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Principal
briefing_dialog.text: Head to the snowfield and locate the expedition camp. Bring the team home safely.
